notes.title: Physics Improved and Save Game Feature Implemented.
notes.content:
We got some sugestions from current players and implemented on the game to turn MegaRamp even better and provide more immersion and funny.


The physics that was implemented in the ball made it look like a bladder. Now we have improved the implementation and the behavior of the ball is much more realistic.

You can now save the level you are playing in order to continue playing later.
